definitions.explanation: The process of becoming old or worn out. Used for both biological aging of living things and physical deterioration of materials, infrastructure, and equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦インフラ→インフラ：09898_infura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{老化|ろうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The deterioration of infrastructure has become a serious problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適度|てきど}→適度：03441_tekido⟧な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{老化|ろうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Moderate exercise and a well-balanced diet are effective in slowing the progression of aging.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in both medical/biological contexts (human aging, cell deterioration) and non-biological contexts (deterioration of buildings, rubber, equipment). Common in health-related discussions and infrastructure policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老化|ろうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent aging
- {老化|ろうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: aging progresses
- {老化|ろうか}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: aging phenomenon
- {老化|ろうか}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: anti-aging
